title: JCS key sort uses UTF-16 code unit order — diverges from RFC 8785 for supplementary-plane characters
rationale: Replaced Object.keys(obj).sort() with Object.keys(obj).sort(compareKeysByCodePoint) in jcs.ts and generate.mjs (which inlines the same logic). compareKeysByCodePoint iterates by codePointAt() advancing index by 2 for supplementary-plane chars (>0xFFFF), by 1 for BMP chars. Added jcs-016-supplementary-plane-key vector (U+1D11E 𝄞 vs 'a') to vectors.json. Updated module comment.
variants_checked: jcs.ts:jcsSerialise — primary fix; fixtures/conformance/generate.mjs:jcsSerialise — same bug, same fix applied; conformance.test.ts — imports production module, no duplication
bypass_considered: U+1D11E vs 'a': old sort compared surrogates 0xD834 vs 0x61 (𝄞 first, wrong); new sort compares code points 0x1D11E vs 0x61 ('a' first, correct per RFC 8785)
test_note: jcs-016-supplementary-plane-key vector in vectors.json picked up automatically by existing conformance.test.ts test.each loop; also added to generate.mjs self-check array
review_reason: All three hunks tightly on the bug path: jcs.ts:30 is the root cause, generate.mjs is an inlined copy of the same logic that carried the same defect, and vectors.json is the conformance fixture consumed directly by the test runner. Comparator correctly uses codePointAt() with surrogate-aware index advance and valid length-difference tie-breaker.
